dataQualityFindings.title: Intimation For Receipt Of Order From GST Authorities
dataQualityFindings.explanation: This is a GST demand order (a tax liability) from the Principal Commissioner of Central Tax, Bengaluru East, rejecting a rectification application for FY2019-20 under Sec 73 CGST Act. The classifier matched on the words 'Receipt Of Order' and the PDF extractor read the demand amount INR 5,71,22,863 as an order win. It must be excluded from the order book.
All four 'resolved' WABAG order values were parsed out of the Order Classification band table printed at the foot of every WABAG filing, not from a disclosed order value.

dataQualityFindings.explanation: The DJB filing's timeline was recorded as 180 months (15 years) ending 2041-05-22. That 15 years is the post-commissioning O&M period; the EPC schedule is 21 months. The extractor picked the longest duration in the document rather than the one answering Annexure row (f).

'75 million' and '150 million' in the USD row were converted as if they were rupees (75 Mn INR = 7.5 Cr). Even setting aside the band-table issue, the extractor has no currency awareness for USD-denominated figures.

The pipeline run persisted 5 order-win events and a ledger cumulative of 17,486.47 Cr, all built on the erroneous values above. The events collection (type: order-win) and data/cache/order-book-ledger/NSE:WABAG.json should be purged and rebuilt for this company once the extractor handles band-only disclosure.
